## Source-support finding

**S1 — Decision scope acquires an unsupported planned duration.**

Draft: “I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att testa en gemensam logg under åtta veckor.”

Complete proposition: In September 2025 the team decided that its shared-log trial would run for eight weeks. The source separately establishes the September decision and the trial's actual eight-week duration. All supplied material could be true if the original trial decision had no predetermined end date, or had a different planned duration and ultimately lasted eight weeks. Therefore the draft's attachment of “under åtta veckor” to what was decided adds decision content.

Smallest supported repair: “I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att testa en gemensam logg. Försöket pågick i åtta veckor.” This preserves both supported facts without implying that the actual duration was decided in advance.

## Translation finding and quotation checks

**T1 — The literal building-as-agent formulation obscures the activity being started.**

Draft: “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa byggnad kommer i gång.”

Source: “I would set that time aside before the next building starts.”

The meaning and conditional stance are otherwise intact, but Swedish “byggnad kommer i gång” leaves a physical building as the entity starting up and does not idiomatically identify the trial activity. The supplied context settles the implicit referent: this is starting the trial in another building, not constructing or operating the building itself.

Smallest idiomatic repair: “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan försöket börjar i nästa byggnad.” This makes only the settled referent explicit and retains the speaker's conditional advice, first person and temporal relation.

The first quotation preserves the evening/morning contrast, completed prior work, customer ownership of categories, and Svale's assisting role. The second quotation's first sentence preserves the comparison between agreement work and first report entry, with no new absolute duration. The final quotation preserves Lind's affirmative conditional endorsement, practical shared-view benefit and extra-week reservation. Its “Det hjälper oss att ha en samlad vy” is idiomatic and equivalent to “Having one view … helps us.” No concrete meaning, certainty or voice obstruction was found in those passages.

The three quotations add, respectively, the specific shift handover purpose and ownership statement; firsthand preparation effort and advice; and Lind's own qualified overall assessment. The draft does not manufacture a universal supplier recommendation. Speech dashes are appropriate to the resolved Swedish convention; email interview attribution accurately signals the source medium.

## Completion status

Complete: every factual or attributed proposition in the full draft, including title, headings, framing and destination claim, has been accounted for. Two unresolved findings remain for the writer: source-support S1 and translation T1. No other source-support or translation findings. Sources and draft were not changed.

# Source and quotation comparison

Read in full: the supplied source.md, complete draft.md and quotations.md. Scope: support, attribution, implications and translated quotation fidelity only. The English package is the entire permitted evidence; Swedish is the resolved target language. No external facts were used.

## Complete claim accounting

Each entry reconstructs the proposition with its contextual scope. “Supported” means that the supplied evidence entails the proposition at the strength presented; no source-compatible counterexample was identified. Quotation contents remain Maya Lind’s attributed experience or assessment, rather than independently established outcomes.

1. **Title: “Elm Quay fick en gemensam vy över felanmälningarna”.** Proposition: Elm Quay acquired a shared view of repair reports in the trial described by the article. Support: “trial a shared repair log in two buildings” and Lind’s “Having one view of the reports helps us”. Supported. This does not promise that every report across all 640 flats was included; the immediately following lead expressly confines the trial to two buildings.

2. **Lead: “Elm Quay Housing prövade en gemensam logg för felanmälningar i två byggnader”.** Proposition: Elm Quay trialled a shared repair log in two buildings. Support: “its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings” together with “The trial lasted eight weeks.” Supported.

3. **Lead: “för att ge personal på olika skift samma information”.** Proposition: The purpose of the trial was to give staff on different shifts access to the same information. Support: “The team wanted staff on different shifts to see the same information.” Supported as purpose, without an asserted measured outcome.

4. **Lead: “Arbetsledaren Maya Lind skulle välja att göra försöket igen”.** Proposition: Maintenance supervisor Maya Lind says she would choose to repeat the trial. Support: “maintenance supervisor Maya Lind” and “I would choose to do the trial again.” Supported; conditional stance retained.

5. **Lead: “men vill avsätta mer tid för förberedelser”.** Proposition: In her assessment of repeating the trial, Lind prefers allowing additional preparation time. Support: “but I would leave an extra week for preparation.” Supported. The preference is tied to her hypothetical repeat choice, not presented as a scheduled new trial.

Support: “The trial has not yet expanded; the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs.” Supported by the explicit future decision, not merely inferred from a lack of expansion.

7. **“Avsändare: Svale Systems.”** Proposition: Svale Systems is the publisher/source of this customer case. Support: “The publisher is the supplier, Svale Systems” and “supplier-published material; it is not independent journalism.” Supported. No independent-publication claim is introduced.

8. **“Elm Quay Housing förvaltar 640 lägenheter.”** Proposition: Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats. Support: “Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats.” Supported.

9. **“Tidigare förvarades felanmälningar via telefon och mejl separat.”** Proposition: Before the shared-log trial, telephone reports and emails were stored separately. Support: “Previously telephone reports and emails were stored separately.” Supported. No claim that telephone reporting ceased follows.

10. **“I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att testa en gemensam logg.”** Proposition: In September 2025, Elm Quay’s own maintenance team decided to trial the shared log. Support: “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log”. Supported. Agency and decision date are preserved.

11. **“Försöket pågick i åtta veckor.”** Proposition: The trial lasted eight weeks. Support: “The trial lasted eight weeks.” Supported; the draft does not invent exact start/end dates.

12. **First quotation: “Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort.”** Proposition: Lind says their intention was for the evening shift to see what the morning shift had already done. Support: “We wanted the evening shift to see what the morning shift had already done.” Supported as attributed intention.

13. **First quotation: “Kategorierna var våra”.** Proposition: Lind attributes ownership/design of the categories to the customer’s team. Support: “The categories were ours” and “The maintenance team designed its categories”. Supported.

14. **First quotation: “Svale hjälpte oss att lägga in dem i loggen”.** Proposition: Lind says Svale helped the team put its categories into the log. Support: “Svale helped us put them into the log.” Supported; supplier assistance is not substituted for customer design.

15. **Attribution: “säger arbetsledaren Maya Lind i en mejlintervju”.** Proposition: The quoted speaker is maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, and the interview medium was email. Support: “Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind” and “All interviews occurred by email”. Supported. The draft does not invent an in-person interview scene.

16. **“Teamet valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation.”** Proposition: The maintenance team selected Svale after testing whether the log could display each repair’s status. Support: “It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair.” Supported. Sequence and scope match; no comparative superiority is asserted.

17. **“Underlaget innehåller ingen jämförelse med andra leverantörer.”** Proposition: The available source package contains no comparison with alternative suppliers. Support: “No comparison with another supplier is available.” Supported. The limitation is correctly about available material, not a claim that no comparison ever occurred.

19. **“behöll möjligheten för de boende att felanmäla via telefon”.** Proposition: Residents retained the option to report repairs by telephone. Support: “kept telephone reporting open for residents”. Supported.

20. **“Svale konfigurerade loggen”.** Proposition: Svale configured the log. Support: “Svale configured the log”. Supported.

21. **“utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen”.** Proposition: Svale trained six staff during two sessions. Support: “trained six staff during two sessions.” Supported; no training duration or individual session attendance is invented.

22. **“För Lind gav arbetet med att komma i gång en erfarenhet att ta med till en eventuell fortsättning”.** Proposition: Lind’s experience preparing the trial informs her stated advice for a possible next building. 23. **Second quotation: “Vi lade mer tid på att komma överens om kategorierna än på att registrera de första anmälningarna.”** Proposition: Lind says agreeing on categories took the team more time than entering the first reports. 24. **Second quotation: “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan försöket börjar i nästa byggnad.”** Proposition: Lind would reserve time for agreeing on categories before commencing the trial in another building. 25. **Heading: “Kortare tid till tilldelning under försöket”.** Proposition: The measured report-to-assignment time was shorter in the trial period than in the preceding comparison period. Support: “Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period.” Supported as the section’s summary of the median comparison, immediately specified in the body. 28. **“Akuta ärenden och arbeten som beställts före försöket ingår inte i sammanställningen.”** Proposition: The note’s summary excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial. Support: “It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial.” Supported. It does not assert that no such cases existed.

29. **“Mediantiden från anmälan till tilldelning var två arbetsdagar under försöket, jämfört med tre under den föregående åttaveckorsperioden.”** Proposition: The median report-to-assignment interval was two working days during the eight-week trial and three working days during the immediately preceding eight weeks. 30. **“Arbetsbelastningen skilde sig mellan perioderna”.** Proposition: Workloads differed between the trial and preceding period. Support: “The periods had different workloads”. Supported. No direction or magnitude of workload difference is invented.

## Source-support findings

No unsupported factual addition, altered attribution or material loss of qualification found. Source-compatible counterexample checks specifically considered: a prior supplier comparison not present in the package (draft does not deny it); emergencies existing but excluded (draft does not deny them); no causal software effect or an unknown effect despite shorter median (draft allows either); slower individual repairs despite a lower median (section establishes a median only); and a future decision against expansion (draft expressly leaves expansion pending). All remain compatible with the draft’s stated claims.

No money saving, resident approval, completion improvement, universal recommendation, invented physical scene, emotion or dialogue is introduced. The customer retains operational agency, and the supplier’s work is attributed narrowly. No source-support repair is required.

## Translated quotation comparison

**Quotation 1:** The Swedish preserves intention, shift order, the morning team’s prior work, customer ownership of categories and Svale’s assistance. “Kategorierna var våra” retains the original compact emphasis. “Lägga in dem i loggen” is idiomatic and has the same settled referent. No concrete obstruction to the same meaning or voice was found.

**Quotation 2:** “Lade mer tid på att komma överens” expresses the comparison and collaborative agreement in ordinary Swedish. “Registrera de första anmälningarna” preserves the limited comparison with initial entries. “Innan försöket börjar i nästa byggnad” explicates the English shorthand “before the next building starts”; the supplied trial-and-expansion context settles that referent. “Jag skulle” retains conditional advice. No translation repair is required.

**Quotation 3:** The Swedish preserves the explicit personal choice, the modest experiential claim that a shared view helps, the contrast introduced by “men”, and exactly one extra week of preparation. “En samlad vy” and “avsätta ... för förberedelser” are idiomatic expressions of the original meanings. No distinctive imagery or register has been flattened, and no certainty has been added. No translation repair is required.

The speech-dash presentation identifies attributed interview speech, and the first attribution accurately identifies email as the interview medium. All three quotations carry source-provided experience or assessment. The first contributes concrete shift continuity and the division of responsibility; the second contributes preparation experience and advice; the third supplies Lind’s actual qualified assessment. No quotation has been assembled from invented speech.

## Completion

Complete: all factual and attributed claims in the title, lead, publisher line, headings, body, quotations and closing link have been accounted for against the full supplied material. Unresolved source-support findings: none. Unresolved translation findings: none.
